items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: Lucille wanted to move next to Jackie Robinson up in Connecticut

ctx.x: It must have been a pretty emotional experience to be going through the things in his home.

Oh my God yes. Oh his wife was, you could have performed surgery in her kitchen. This woman was a clean freak like you don’t believe. She had Louis’ clothes, everything, their house was, well you’ve just got to go to see their house, you’re just not going to believe it. ‘Cause Lucille was, see Lucille wanted to move next to Jackie Robinson up in Connecticut. And they could well afford it. But Pops said, “Look, you wanna go move there, give me the address I’ll send you a check but I’m staying right here. I like my…
